definitions.explanation: An equal split or balance between two sides, outcomes, or possibilities. Used to describe situations where neither side has an advantage.

examples.japanese: ⟦{勝|か}つ→勝つ：01199_katsu⟧⟦{確率|かくりつ}→確率：00159_kakuritsu⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{五分五分|ごぶごぶ}だ。
examples.english: The odds of winning are fifty-fifty.

examples.japanese: ⟦{両|りょう}→両：11182_ryou⟧⟦チーム→チーム：03858_chiimu⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{実力|じつりょく}→実力：03277_jitsuryoku⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{五分五分|ごぶごぶ}だ⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{思|おも}う→思う：00492_omou⟧。
examples.english: I think both teams are evenly matched.

examples.japanese: ⟦{手術|しゅじゅつ}→手術：03218_shujutsu⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{成功|せいこう}する→成功する：21445_seikousuru⟧⟦かどうか→かどうか：28299_kadouka⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{五分五分|ごぶごぶ}だ⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{医者|いしゃ}→医者：02847_isha⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{言|い}われた→言う：00515_iu⟧。
examples.english: The doctor told me the chances of the surgery succeeding were fifty-fifty.

notes:
An expression using {分|ぶ}, a traditional unit meaning one-tenth. Five-tenths plus five-tenths equals a whole, conveying the idea of a perfectly even split. Very commonly used in everyday conversation.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {五分五分|ごぶごぶ}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{勝負|しょうぶ}→勝負：01437_shoubu⟧: an even match
- {五分五分|ごぶごぶ}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{確率|かくりつ}→確率：00159_kakuritsu⟧: a fifty-fifty chance
- {五分五分|ごぶごぶ}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{戦|たたか}い→戦い：02070_tatakai⟧: an evenly fought battle

USAGE:
Can be used as a noun ({五分五分|ごぶごぶ}だ) or as a modifier ({五分五分|ごぶごぶ}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧). Often used when discussing the outcome of competitions, elections, medical procedures, or any situation with uncertain results.

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{互角|ごかく}→互角：16716_gokaku⟧: evenly matched — emphasizes equal ability or strength between opponents
- ⟦{半々|はんはん}→半々：20666_hanhan⟧: half-and-half — used more for splitting things (costs, portions) rather than competition outcomes
- {拮抗|きっこう}: closely contested — more formal, often used in written language
